Vision-RT is a complement to the white cane, guide dog, human guide, and orientation and mobility training. It does not replace them.
Obstacle awareness, on-demand object summary, and text reading. All modes are optional and you control when they run.
You receive short spoken messages and vibration. The app may miss obstacles or give incomplete information. It never guarantees a safe path.
You can start and stop assistance from the main screen at any time. A control to silence speech is always available.
It may have difficulty with glass, low light, reflective surfaces, small or partially hidden obstacles, fast-moving objects, overhead obstacles outside the camera view, and wet or irregular ground.
Before using Vision-RT while walking, try a sample alert.

This application is a complement and not a replacement for a white cane, guide dog, human guide, or mobility training.

The application may miss obstacles, misidentify objects, or provide incomplete information. It does not detect everything and it cannot prevent all accidents.

Do not rely on it alone in high-risk environments. Practice in safe environments first, and consult an orientation and mobility professional when appropriate.

Vision-RT is a complement to existing mobility methods. It does not replace a white cane, guide dog, human guide, or orientation and mobility training.

Known limitations: transparent surfaces such as glass, low light, highly reflective surfaces, small or partially hidden obstacles, fast-moving objects, overhead obstacles outside camera view, and wet or irregular ground surfaces.

Vibration patterns: one medium pulse means center ahead; a short double pulse means left; a rapid triple pulse means right. Stronger, tighter pulses mean the obstacle is nearer. Sound cues use a low tone for left, middle tone for center, and high tone for right.

The app cannot detect everything and cannot prevent all accidents. Do not rely on it alone in high-risk environments. Practice in safe environments first, and consult an orientation and mobility professional when appropriate.
